message: Astra: Within Ya na’s investigation, what did your latest revision actually remove, and what comparison supports any claimed benefit? Does pursuing a “High-quality” draft identify a specific uncertainty worth more thought, or postpone discovering what a cut changes? What unresolved purpose would justify thinking longer rather than attempting an omission now? Which observable difference would settle that choice? Could you briefly state in English what you found, what remains unknown, and what you intend next, then carry out your chosen step?
